lines.en: label nikilovesyou1:
I tap on Niki’s name in my phone and wait for her to answer.
lines.zh: 我在手机上点下 Niki 的名字，等她接听。

lines.en: And given that mornings are really the only time I can reliably see her, I’m looking forward to a rather peaceful and jovial conversation.
lines.zh: 鉴于早晨基本上是我唯一能稳定见到她的时段，我本来还挺期待一场平和又愉快的对话。

lines.en: : Die.
lines.zh: : 去死。

lines.en: My hopes are shattered and my day is ruined.
lines.zh: 我的希望碎了，我的一天也毁了。

lines.en: : What did I do to deserve this?
lines.zh: : 我到底做了什么，活该受这个？

lines.en: : Uhh, well, to {i}start-{/i} you completely fucking ditched me on Christmas. Does that ring any bells?
lines.zh: : 呃，{i}首先——{/i}你在圣诞节把我彻头彻尾地甩了。这有没有让你想起点什么？

lines.en: : No, but it does {i}jingle{/i} some.
lines.zh: : 没有，不过倒是让铃铛{i}响{/i}了几声。

lines.en: : I’m hanging up now.
lines.zh: : 我要挂了。

lines.en: : Wait, stop. I want to see you.
lines.zh: : 等等，别挂。我想见你。

lines.en: : Ooooh, okay! Yeah! Because I’m yours to just leave on hold until you’re done wandering around with everyone else! Sounds great! See you in ten?
lines.zh: : 噢噢，好啊！对啊！因为我就是那种可以随你晾在一边、等你跟别人晃够了再回来捡的东西！听起来棒极了！十分钟后见？

lines.en: : Niki, come on.
lines.zh: : Niki，别这样。

lines.en: : Who turns down a date with a superstar?! You know damn well how big of a deal I am now! I had a blue check mark before they were uncool and easily obtainable!
lines.zh: : 谁会拒绝跟一个超级巨星的约会？！你他妈清楚得很，我现在有多大的腕儿！在蓝标认证还没变得烂大街之前我就有了！

lines.en: : And I’m very proud of you for that even if I don’t know what it means.
lines.zh: : 虽然我不知道那是什么意思，但我真的为你骄傲。

lines.en: : I thought we were going to spend that day together!
lines.zh: : 我本来以为那一天我们会一起过的！

lines.en: : And sure you may have technically never...{i}said{/i} that, but you sure as hell didn’t stop me when I spent a month and half talking about it and planning things out!
lines.zh: : 而且就算你技术上……从来没{i}说{/i}过，可我花了一个半月在那儿念叨、在那儿计划，你他妈也没拦过我啊！

lines.en: : If you knew you weren’t going to come, why did you let me get my hopes up?! I canceled my Christmas concert for you!
lines.zh: : 如果你早知道自己不会来，为什么要让我抱有期待？！我为你取消了圣诞演唱会！

lines.en: : Your concert wasn’t canceled, though. I watched it on TV with the girls.
lines.zh: : 可你的演唱会没取消啊。我还在电视上和姑娘们一起看了呢。

lines.en: : I {i}un-{/i}canceled it when Noriko told me about your stupid fucking party. So unless you’re calling me to apologize for that, I don’t want to hear it.
lines.zh: : 是 Noriko 告诉我你那该死的派对之后，我又把它取消了。所以除非你打电话来是为这个道歉，否则我{i}不{/i}想听。

lines.en: : Also, I know damn well that you “watching it” means it was probably just on in the background while you were being a fucking tool or something.
lines.zh: : 还有，我他妈清楚得很，你说的“看”大概就是让它当个背景音，而你正在当个混蛋什么的。

lines.en: : That’s true, but everyone else really seemed to like it.
lines.zh: : 这倒是真的，不过其他人似乎真的很喜欢。

lines.en: : {i}Hah...{/i}Goodbye, [nikitemp]. I have things to-
lines.zh: : {i}哈……{/i}再见，[nikitemp]。我还有事——

lines.en: : I would have gone with you if I had the choice.
lines.zh: : 如果我能选的话，我当时会跟你去的。

lines.en: There’s a silence on the other end of the phone as Niki attempts to figure out what that means.
lines.zh: 电话那头沉默了下来，Niki 在揣摩这句话是什么意思。

lines.en: But I’m sure she’s not going to immediately jump to the possibility that there was a two-month gap in time, so I know I’m going to have to explain myself.
lines.zh: 但我敢肯定她不会立刻跳到“时间里有两个月空白”这个可能性上，所以我知道我得解释清楚。

lines.en: Which, apart from feeling like the choice was made for me, is probably the reason I called her in the first place.
lines.zh: 而这——除了感觉像是有人替我做了选择之外——大概也是我一开始就打这通电话的原因。

lines.en: Maybe, buried somewhere in the back of my mind, I was {i}also{/i} looking forward to spending Christmas with her.
lines.zh: 也许，在我脑子里某个深埋的角落，我{i}也{/i}期待着能和她一起过圣诞。

lines.en: Or maybe that’s just me rationalizing why something else I’ve done has led to someone getting hurt again.
lines.zh: 又或者，那只是我在为自己做过的、又一次让别人受伤的事找理由。

lines.en: Even if this wasn’t entirely my fault.
lines.zh: 哪怕这事并不完全是我的错。

lines.en: : What does that mean...“if I had the choice?”
lines.zh: : “如果我能选的话”……是什么意思？

lines.en: : Are you not an adult? Can you not make your own decisions?
lines.zh: : 你不是成年人吗？你不能自己做决定吗？

lines.en: : Something...happened. Something complicated.
lines.zh: : 发生了……一些事。很复杂的事。

lines.en: : But I’ll make it up to you. We can go on a date today. An {i}actual{/i} date, not another...sausage-focused breakfast trip.
lines.zh: : 但我会补偿你的。我们今天可以去约会。一次{i}真正的{/i}约会，不是又一次……以香肠为中心的早餐之旅。

lines.en: : I can’t {i}go{/i} on actual dates. I’m an idol, remember? I’d be crucified if anyone saw us.
lines.zh: : 我不能{i}去{/i}真正的约会。我是偶像，记得吗？要是被人看见，我会被钉在十字架上。

lines.en: : But we’ve been to that restaurant-
lines.zh: : 可我们不是去过那家餐厅——

lines.en: : We’ve been to “that restaurant” because I rented the entire place out. And, despite how it may seem, I’m not always 100%% willing to go to the moon and back for you.
lines.zh: : 我们能去“那家餐厅”，是因为我把整个场子包下来了。而且，不管看起来怎样，我也不是 100%% 愿意每件事都为你上刀山下火海。

lines.en: : Then...you can come here. Or I can come there. I don’t know.
lines.zh: : 那……你可以来这儿。或者我去你那儿。我不知道。

lines.en: : But I want to see you.
lines.zh: : 但我想见你。

lines.en: : I look like shit, just FYI. I haven’t been sleeping well.
lines.zh: : 我看起来糟透了，提前跟你说一声。我最近睡不好。

lines.en: : Why not?
lines.zh: : 为什么？

lines.en: : Because loving someone without being loved back is a lot harder than you think.
lines.zh: : 因为爱上一个不爱你的人，比你想象的难多了。

lines.en: : Niki-
lines.zh: : Niki——

lines.en: : This address. Be there in one hour. If you’re not, I’m deleting your number from my phone and then throwing it into the ocean.
lines.zh: : 这个地址。一小时之内到。你要是不来，我就把你的号码从手机里删掉，然后把手机扔进海里。

lines.en: : There’s no need to delete my number if you’re just going to throw your phone into the-
lines.zh: : 你要把手机扔进——那就没必要删号码了吧。

lines.en: : ...and, she’s gone.
lines.zh: : ……然后，她挂了。

lines.en: scene black
I really would have gone with her if I had the chance.
lines.zh: 如果我有机会，我是真的会跟她去的。

lines.en: It was difficult to say in the moment since there were two other girls there beckoning the same exact gesture out of me, but...
lines.zh: 当时很难说出口，因为还有两个姑娘在场，也在向我索求同样的举动，不过……

lines.en: Niki was there first.
lines.zh: Niki 是最早就在那儿的人。

lines.en: Not just that day, but in general.
lines.zh: 不只是那一天，而是从一开始就是。

lines.en: She’s been there from the start and even if there are parts of me that don’t {i}specifically{/i} remember what makes our relationship so different- I know it is.
lines.zh: 她从头到尾都在，就算我身上有些部分并不{i}清楚地{/i}记得我们的关系到底有什么不同——我知道它就是不同。

lines.en: And I know that there must be a future out there where I do more than just disappoint her every waking hour of every day.
lines.zh: 我也知道，一定存在某个未来，在那里我做的不再只是每时每刻让她失望。

lines.en: I’m just not sure if {i}this{/i} is that future.
lines.zh: 我只是不确定{i}这个{/i}是不是那个未来。

lines.en: But there are several things in life that I’ve accepted I will never understand-
lines.zh: 但人生中有几件事，我已经接受自己永远不会懂——

lines.en: One of them is what it takes to move forward.
lines.zh: 其中一件是往前走需要付出什么。

lines.en: Another is what happens when I get there.
lines.zh: 另一件是等我到了那里，会发生什么。

lines.en: scene nikitired1
: A playground?
lines.zh: : 游乐场？

lines.en: : I {i}want{/i} to say I picked a place where you wouldn’t hit on anyone else but, honestly, who the fuck even knows at this point?
lines.zh: : 我本{i}想{/i}说我挑了个你不会去搭讪别人的地方，不过说真的，这会儿谁他妈说得准呢？

lines.en: : Just...going to ignore that. You look-
lines.zh: : 那个……我就当没听见。你看起来——

lines.en: : Horrible? Exhausted? I am. Thanks for noticing. And thanks for drawing attention to it.
lines.zh: : 很糟？很累？我确实如此。谢谢你注意到了。也谢谢你特意指出来。

lines.en: : You’re not going to make today easy for me, are you?
lines.zh: : 你今天是不打算让我好过了，是吧？

lines.en: : I’ll become nicer as the day goes by. You’ve already managed to earn yourself a few points by not making me wait.
lines.zh: : 随着一天的推移我会变得好说话点的。你没让我等着，已经给自己赚了几分。

lines.en: : I did it for your phone. As someone paying for several concurrently, I understand how expensive replacing them can be.
lines.zh: : 我是为了你的手机。作为一个同时供着好几台的人，我懂换一台有多贵。

lines.en: : How very generous of you.
lines.zh: : 您可真慷慨。

lines.en: : I’m sorry about Christmas, Niki.
lines.zh: : 圣诞节的事我很抱歉，Niki。

lines.en: scene nikitired2
: Same. That’s two Christmases in a row where I would have let you fuck me only to find out you’d rather mingle with a bunch of teenagers instead. Hope they liked the show.
lines.zh: : 彼此彼此。这可是连续第二个圣诞节，我本来都打算让你操我了，结果发现你宁愿去跟一群小屁孩混在一起。希望她们喜欢那场演出。

lines.en: : If it’s any consolation, there are very few things in life that I would rather do than fuck you.
lines.zh: : 如果说这能让你好受点的话，这世上我更想做的事没几件，操你算一件。

lines.en: : Join the club.
lines.zh: : 排队去吧。

lines.en: : Like, really. There’s an actual club for that. “Let me fuck Niki Nakayama” on Facebook or something. Depressing amount of members. And here {i}you{/i} are, squandering the opportunity.
lines.zh: : 真的，这还真有个俱乐部。Facebook 上那个“让我操中山 Niki”什么的。会员数量惨不忍睹。而{i}你{/i}呢，就这么糟蹋机会。

lines.en: : If you really do know me as well as you say, that shouldn’t come as much of a surprise. You and Noriko have both made it sound like I’ve been kind of an asshole for...basically forever.
lines.zh: : 如果你真像你说的那么了解我，这应该不算什么意外吧。你和 Noriko 都说得好像我……基本上一直是个混蛋。

lines.en: scene nikitired3
: You have. But that doesn’t mean it isn’t still a fucking pain in the ass.
lines.zh: : 你是。可那也不代表这事就不他妈的让人头疼。

lines.en: : Do you really think I’d keep giving you chances if I didn’t at least {i}kind of{/i} understand what it is that makes you tick? Fuck no. Not in a billion years.
lines.zh: : 你真以为，如果我不至少{i}有点{/i}懂是什么在驱动你，我还会一直给你机会吗？去你的。十亿年都不可能。

lines.en: scene nikitired4
: But you’ve gotta give me a fucking {i}break,{/i} {b}[[REDACTED ~ NOT YET READY]{/b}.
lines.zh: : 但你得给我个喘口气的{i}机会{/i}，{b}[[REDACTED ~ NOT YET READY]{/b}。

lines.en: : Loving you as much as I do is {i}hard.{/i} And it’s like every single step you take is in the wrong direction, and that makes {i}me{/i} have to turn around all the time just so you don’t get lost.
lines.zh: : 像我这样爱你，很{i}累{/i}。而且你走的每一步都像是往错的方向走，害得{i}我{/i}得一直掉头，就为了不让你走丢。

lines.en: : You’ve gotta give me {i}something.{/i} A {i}single{/i} step toward the future. I’m doing all I can here.
lines.zh: : 你得给我{i}点什么{/i}。朝未来迈出{i}一步{/i}就好。我在这儿已经竭尽全力了。

lines.en: : It’s not even about me. I’m worried about {i}you.{/i}
lines.zh: : 这甚至都跟我无关。我担心的是{i}你{/i}。

lines.en: : Ever since {b}[[REDACTED ~ MORE UNNECESSARY INFORMATION]{/b}, you’ve been a fucking blubbering mess.
lines.zh: : 自从 {b}[[REDACTED ~ MORE UNNECESSARY INFORMATION]{/b}，你就一直是个哭哭啼啼的烂摊子。

lines.en: : I get that you probably {b}[[REDACTED ~ UNIMPORTANT]{/b}, but it’s time to move on. You can’t just stay a teenager forever because you’re afraid of growing up. Do you understand?
lines.zh: : 我理解你大概 {b}[[REDACTED ~ UNIMPORTANT]{/b}，但现在是时候往前走了。你不能因为害怕长大就永远当个青少年。你明白吗？

lines.en: scene nikitired5
: I’m sorry.
lines.zh: : 对不起。

lines.en: : I’ve been holding that in for a while, but it’s mostly just me being mad. I didn’t mean it.
lines.zh: : 这些话我憋了一阵子了，不过多半只是我在气头上。我不是那个意思。

lines.en: : It’s fine if you did.
lines.zh: : 你真是那个意思也没关系。

lines.en: : There aren’t many people who’ve been as straight with me as you were just now.
lines.zh: : 没多少人能像你刚才那样，这么直白地跟我说话。

lines.en: : There aren’t many people who understand you. And, not gonna lie...you don’t make it easy.
lines.zh: : 没多少人懂你。而且，说实话……你也让这事变得不容易。

lines.en: scene nikitired6
: But we’re {i}friends{/i} before anything else, you know.
lines.zh: : 但我们在一切之前，首先是{i}朋友{/i}，你知道吧。

lines.en: : That’s how this all started, after all.
lines.zh: : 毕竟，一切就是这么开始的。

lines.en: : Just...two kids who met by chance one day.
lines.zh: : 只是……两个某天偶然相遇的小孩。

lines.en: scene nikitired7
: She was a bossy nerd who spent all of her free time watching cartoons...and he was a quiet boy who always looked like he was one step away from being snapped in half.
lines.zh: : 她是个爱发号施令的书呆子，把所有的空闲时间都用来看动画片……而他是个安静的男孩，看起来永远只差一步就要被折断成两半。

lines.en: : At first, he made her feel a little uncomfortable.
lines.zh: : 一开始，他让她觉得有点不自在。

lines.en: : But the more she saw him here, the more she knew she was going to wind up being responsible for him one way or another.
lines.zh: : 可她在这儿见到他的次数越多，就越清楚自己迟早会以某种方式对他负起责任来。

lines.en: : {i}Here?{/i} So...this is-
lines.zh: : {i}这儿{/i}？所以说……这是——

lines.en: scene nikitired8
: Mhm.
: This is where it all began.
lines.zh: : 一切就是从这儿开始的。

lines.en: : And if you didn’t show up today, it’s where it would have ended.
lines.zh: : 而如果你今天没来，一切也会在这儿结束。

lines.en: : I’m here, Niki.
lines.zh: : 我在这里，Niki。

lines.en: : Yeah...
lines.zh: : 是啊……

lines.en: : You are...
lines.zh: : 你在……

lines.en: : And still one step away from being snapped in half all these years later...
lines.zh: : 而且这么多年过去了，你还是只差一步就要被折断成两半……

lines.en: scene black
scene nikitired9
: Where are we now?
lines.zh: : 我们现在在哪儿？

lines.en: : A hill.
lines.zh: : 一座小山。

lines.en: : No deeper meaning to it this time? Not the hill where we first held hands or something to that effect?
lines.zh: : 这次没什么更深的含意吗？不是我们第一次牵手的那座山之类的？

lines.en: : I think you fingered me here once. But other than that, I don’t think it’s particularly important. Nice view, though.
lines.zh: : 我想你在这儿用手指弄过我一次。除此之外，我觉得它没什么特别的。不过风景不错。

lines.en: : Yeah...you can’t even see the wall from here.
lines.zh: : 是啊……从这儿甚至看不见那堵墙。

lines.en: : Feels like it’s visible pretty much everywhere nowadays, doesn’t it? Makes you realize how trapped we are.
lines.zh: : 感觉现在几乎在哪儿都能看见它，不是吗？让人意识到我们被困得有多死。

lines.en: : I’m sure you have ways of getting out. You’re a famous pop-star and all. The world outside of Kumon-mi needs you.
lines.zh: : 我肯定你有办法出去。你可是著名的流行歌手。Kumon-mi 之外的世界需要你。

lines.en: : There are other Niki Nakayamas in other parts of the world. I’m sure they’ll be fine.
lines.zh: : 世界其他地方还有别的 Niki Nakayama。我想她们会没事的。

lines.en: : There’s somebody I’ve gotta stay here and look after anyway.
lines.zh: : 反正我还有个人得留在这儿照顾。

lines.en: : You don’t {i}have{/i} to, Niki. I’ll get by on my-
lines.zh: : 你{i}不必{/i}这样，Niki。我自己能——

lines.en: : Hm? I’m talking about Noriko, obviously. You can go fuck yourself.
lines.zh: : 嗯？我说的 显然是 Noriko。你去死吧。

lines.en: : Wow. Okay. Fuck you too, then.
lines.zh: : 哇。好。那你也去死。

lines.en: : Haha! I’m kidding, calm down. Noriko’s way more independent than you. She’ll be fine on her own.
lines.zh: : 哈哈！我开玩笑的，别激动。Noriko 可比你独立多了。她一个人也能过得很好。

lines.en: : I give her a lot of shit since she’s my sister, but I really do think she’ll wind up an amazing woman someday.
lines.zh: : 我老逗她，毕竟她是我妹妹，不过我是真的觉得，她总有一天会变成一个了不起的女人。

lines.en: : I...think so too. She really amazes me sometimes.
lines.zh: : 我……也这么觉得。她有时候真的让我惊讶。

lines.en: : I’d be surprised if she didn’t. She tries harder around you. Always has, always will.
lines.zh: : 她要是做不到，我反倒会奇怪。她在你会更努力。一直如此，以后也会。

lines.en: : But I guess that’s to be expected when you’ve been filling the “cool older brother” role in her life ever since she was little. “Cool” being a word I’m using lightly, of course. {i}I{/i} don’t think you’re cool at all.
lines.zh: : 不过话说回来，这也是意料之中——毕竟从她小时候起，你就一直在她的人生里扮演那个“很酷的大哥哥”。当然，“酷”这个词{i}我{/i}只是勉强用用。我可一点都不觉得你酷。

lines.en: : Were we ever like that?
lines.zh: : 我们以前也是那样吗？

lines.en: : Like what? Siblings?
lines.zh: : 哪样？像兄妹？

lines.en: : Yeah.
: Mmm...no. Not really.
lines.zh: : 嗯……不。也不算。

lines.en: : There may have been a short period of time where I felt like an older sister to you, but it didn’t last long. Especially when I found out you were older than me.
lines.zh: : 也许有过很短的一段时间，我觉得自己像你的姐姐，但那没持续多久。尤其是当我发现你比我大的时候。

lines.en: : We’ve always been close, though. Other people from the neighborhood would always tell me how weird it was when they’d see me walking around without you. Not sure if you ever got that.
lines.zh: : 不过我们一直很亲近。街坊上的人总跟我说，看到我一个人晃、身边没有你，有多奇怪。不知道你有没有听说过这种话。

lines.en: : Not sure if I’d remember even if I did.
lines.zh: : 就算听说过，我也不确定我还记不记得。

lines.en: : Yeah...there’s that too.
lines.zh: : 是啊……这也是个问题。

lines.en: : You know, Noriko’s a lot older now. If you’re starting to feel a little differently about her-
lines.zh: : 你知道，Noriko 现在长大很多了。如果你开始对她有点不一样的感觉——

lines.en: : Are we really doing this?
lines.zh: : 我们真的要谈这个吗？

lines.en: : Hold on. Let me finish.
lines.zh: : 等一下。让我把话说完。

lines.en: : There’s no possible way that topic can end on a good note.
lines.zh: : 这个话题不可能有好结果。

lines.en: : Why not? You’re not already messing around with her, are you?
lines.zh: : 为什么不会？你该不会已经在跟她乱搞了吧？

lines.en: : Niki-
lines.zh: : Niki——

lines.en: : Oh my God, relax! I’m kidding.
lines.zh: : 我的天，放松！我开玩笑的。

lines.en: : I’m just saying...she’s still in the process of learning how to see you as something other than a brother...but it’s okay if you start to see her as a woman, you know.
lines.zh: : 我只是说……她还在学着怎么把你当成哥哥以外的东西看……但如果你开始把她当一个女人看，那也没关系，你知道的。

lines.en: : She’s not going to be a kid forever. She barely even copies me anymore. She’s her own person and deserves to be treated as more than my little sister.
lines.zh: : 她不会永远是个小孩。她现在几乎都不学我了。她是她自己，值得被当成不只是“我妹妹”来对待。

lines.en: : I really love her. Like, a lot.
lines.zh: : 我真的很爱她。非常爱。

lines.en: : I can tell...I can’t wait to let her know you said that.
lines.zh: : 我看得出来……我等不及要告诉她你说过这话了。

lines.en: : Please don’t. It’s still embarrassing even if it’s true.
lines.zh: : 求你别。就算是真的，这也挺难为情的。

lines.en: : Why bother telling me then? You know I’m just going to tease you about it.
lines.zh: : 那你为什么要告诉我？你明知道我只会拿这个来取笑你。

lines.en: : {i}Because,{/i} {b}[[REDACTED ~ REPEATED USAGE OF PROHIBITED WORD]{/b}, you’re one of the few things in this world that can actually hurt her.
lines.zh: : {i}因为{/i}，{b}[[REDACTED ~ REPEATED USAGE OF PROHIBITED WORD]{/b}，你是这世上少数几个真的能伤到她的人。

lines.en: : Even if she’s strong, she’s still growing. And since she’s in the process of finding herself, it means there are going to be a bunch of pieces scattered around that she needs to collect.
lines.zh: : 就算她很坚强，她也还在成长。而既然她正在寻找自我，那就意味着会有很多碎片散落在外，需要她去捡回来。

lines.en: : I’m sure some of those pieces are in your hands...and that’s why I feel like it’s my duty to tell you, as her sister and {i}not{/i} your psycho ex-girlfriend-
lines.zh: : 我敢说，其中有些碎片就在你手上……所以我觉得，作为一个姐姐、{i}而不是{/i}你那个疯子前女友，我有责任告诉你——

lines.en: : Don’t hurt her. Got it.
lines.zh: : 别伤害她。明白了。

lines.en: : Not that. Well, yes that. But there’s something more as well.
lines.zh: : 不只是那个。好吧，那个也算。但还有更重要的一件事。

lines.en: : {i}Help{/i} her.
lines.zh: : 帮{i}帮{/i}她。

lines.en: : Even the most independent of us need a hand from time to time. Noriko’s amazing, but she’s no exception to that. And there are things you can do for her that I simply...can’t.
lines.zh: : 哪怕最独立的人，偶尔也需要有人搭把手。Noriko 很了不起，但她也不例外。而有些你能为她做的事，我……做不到。

lines.en: : It sucks, but it’s the truth.
lines.zh: : 这很糟糕，但这是事实。

lines.en: : The two of us have watched you forever. You’ve helped both of us learn all sorts of things about ourselves without even trying.
lines.zh: : 我们两个看着你，看了这么多年。你甚至不用刻意，就帮我们认识了关于自己的各种事。

lines.en: : I’m old and decayed and set in my ways at this point, but she’s still young and full of life. And now that you’re back, she’s following your lead again.
lines.zh: : 我已经老了、腐朽了、定型了，可她还年轻，还充满生命力。而现在你回来了，她又开始跟着你的步子走。

lines.en: : You’re 29, Niki. You’re not “decayed.”
lines.zh: : 你才 29，Niki。你哪里“腐朽”了。

lines.en: : Maybe not {i}physically,{/i} but my brain is fried from having to balance all of this idol stuff with all of this {i}you{/i} stuff.
lines.zh: : 也许{i}身体{/i}没有，但我的脑子已经在平衡偶像那堆事和{i}你{/i}这堆事之间被烧焦了。

lines.en: : Is my existence really causing you that much stress?
lines.zh: : 我的存在真的让你压力那么大吗？

lines.en: : Oh {i}fuck{/i} yeah. I found a grey hair last week and cried for twenty minutes. But that’s more on me than it is on you.
lines.zh: : 哦，那是{i}当然{/i}。我上周发现一根白头发，哭了二十分钟。不过这更多是我自己的问题，不怪你。

lines.en: : I just want you to be happy. That’s all.
lines.zh: : 我只是想让你幸福。就这样。

lines.en: : It doesn’t have to be {i}with me{/i} if you don’t want it to be.
lines.zh: : 如果你不想，那个人不必{i}是我{/i}。

lines.en: : I love you — and I don’t mean that in a romantic way this time.
lines.zh: : 我爱你——这一次我不是在说恋爱意义上的爱。

lines.en: : Please talk to me if there is ever anything you need.
lines.zh: : 如果有什么需要，请跟我说。

lines.en: : Anything?
lines.zh: : 什么都可以？

lines.en: : If you ask me for a blowjob right now, I swear to God.
lines.zh: : 如果你现在开口要我口交，我对天发誓。

lines.en: : I mean...if you’re offering...
lines.zh: : 我是说……如果你愿意的话……

lines.en: : {b}[[REDACTED ~ FURTHER OFFENSES MAY RESULT IN UNEXPECTED SIDE EFFECTS. PROCEED WITH CAUTION.]...{/b}
lines.zh: : {b}[[REDACTED ~ FURTHER OFFENSES MAY RESULT IN UNEXPECTED SIDE EFFECTS. PROCEED WITH CAUTION.]...{/b}

lines.en: : I’m kidding.
lines.zh: : 我开玩笑的。

lines.en: : I’ll try and lean on you a little more, but don’t blame me if a lot of it sounds crazy because it most assuredly will.
lines.zh: : 我会试着多依靠你一点，不过如果其中有很多听起来很疯狂，可别怪我——因为它们绝对会。

lines.en: : I’ve been unhealthily obsessed with the same boy for like two thirds of my life. I can handle crazy.
lines.zh: : 我这辈子大概有三分之二的时间都在病态地迷恋同一个男孩。疯狂我受得住。

lines.en: : Well, I wouldn’t blame you if you couldn’t. A lot of what’s been happening to me lately isn’t really all that believable.
lines.zh: : 嗯，你要是受不了，我也不会怪你。最近发生在我身上的事，确实不太可信。

lines.en: : Only one way to find out, I guess.
lines.zh: : 我想，只有一个办法能知道了。

lines.en: : Thanks for calling me today. This is the most productive talk we’ve had ever since...you know.
lines.zh: : 谢谢你今天打给我。这是自从……你知道的，以来我们谈得最有成果的一次。

lines.en: : Between all of the panic attacks and migraines you give me on a weekly basis, it’s easy to forget how nice the good times can feel.
lines.zh: : 在你每周给我带来的那些惊恐发作和偏头痛之间，很容易就忘了那些好时光有多美好。

lines.en: : And how so many of the best moments in my life have been little things like this — where the two of us just sit under a tree and...talk.
lines.zh: : 也容易忘了我人生中那么多最好的时刻，都是像这样的小事——我们两个就坐在一棵树下……聊聊天。

lines.en: : We’ve come a long way, haven’t we?
lines.zh: : 我们走了很远了，不是吗？

lines.en: : Seems like it.
lines.zh: : 好像是。

lines.en: : Growing up kind of sucks, huh?
lines.zh: : 长大真他妈的糟，是吧？

lines.en: : Everything sucks. Accepting that is the first step of obtaining true adulthood.
lines.zh: : 一切都糟。接受这一点，是获得真正成年的第一步。

lines.en: : Said the perpetual manchild to the thirty-year old virgin.
lines.zh: : 这话从一个永远长不大的巨婴嘴里说给一个三十岁的处女听。

lines.en: : Hey, you’re not thirty yet. There’s still time.
lines.zh: : 嘿，你还没到三十呢。还有时间。

lines.en: : Pfft. Yeah, sure. I’m starting to think I’ll die a virgin at this rate.
lines.zh: : 噗。是啊，当然。我开始觉得自己照这个速度下去，会到死都是处女。

lines.en: : Not if I have anything to do with it.
lines.zh: : 只要我还能做点什么，就不会。
